request_description: Fast-paced battle theme with driving drums and brass fanfares, high intensity combat music

spec.description: A high-intensity battle theme driven by thunderous orchestral drums and blazing brass fanfares, with relentless momentum and heroic urgency. Punchy timpani hits and aggressive horn stabs surge forward over a bed of driving percussion, evoking epic combat and adrenaline-fueled confrontation.
spec.style_hint: Yasunori Mitsuda or Hitoshi Sakimoto JRPG battle theme, Final Fantasy Tactics orchestral style

request_description: Epic orchestral boss battle theme with heavy percussion, choir, and dark dramatic tension

spec.description: A thunderous orchestral boss battle theme driven by massive taiko drums and pounding timpani, layered with a dark choral ensemble chanting ominous Latin-style phrases. Sweeping brass stabs and razor-sharp string ostinatos build relentless dramatic tension, evoking a climactic confrontation with an overwhelming evil force.
spec.style_hint: Nobuo Uematsu One-Winged Angel style, modern JRPG epic boss theme circa 2010s-2020s

request_description: Gentle exploration theme with acoustic guitar and flute, evoking a sunlit meadow

spec.description: A gentle, airy exploration theme featuring fingerpicked acoustic guitar and soft breathy flute melodies weaving together over warm ambient pads. Sunlit and serene, evoking wandering through an open meadow on a calm morning, with a light pastoral feel and natural, organic textures.
spec.style_hint: Hayao Miyazaki / Studio Ghibli game soundtrack feel, Joe Hisaishi pastoral style

request_description: Deep space ambient music with low drones, shimmer textures, and subtle evolving tones

spec.description: Vast, immersive deep space ambient soundscape featuring slow low-frequency drones that rumble beneath shimmering metallic pad textures. Subtle evolving tones drift and morph like cosmic nebulae, creating a sense of infinite silence and weightless exploration. Cold, ethereal synthesizer layers breathe slowly with gentle reverb tails fading into darkness.
spec.style_hint: Brian Eno ambient style meets sci-fi video game soundtrack, Mass Effect deep space exploration atmosphere

request_description: Curious wandering music with plucked strings and light woodwinds, sense of discovery

spec.description: A gentle, curious melody carried by plucked lute and pizzicato strings, weaving through airy flute and oboe phrases that float like sunlight through leaves. The music has a wandering, exploratory quality with soft rhythmic plucks driving a light, bouncy forward motion, evoking the feeling of stepping into an unknown world full of wonder and possibility.
spec.style_hint: Yasunori Mitsuda pastoral style, early JRPG overworld exploration, Chrono Trigger world map feel

request_description: Dark and tense dungeon crawl music with low strings, sparse percussion, and eerie echoes

spec.description: A brooding, atmospheric dungeon crawl cue built on low tremolo strings and sparse, hollow percussion hits that echo into darkness. Eerie sustained tones drift beneath occasional dissonant stabs, creating a sense of lurking danger and deep underground dread. The texture is sparse yet oppressive, with reverb-drenched sound design evoking cold stone corridors and unseen threats.
spec.style_hint: FromSoftware dungeon atmosphere, Yasunori Mitsuda dark ambient style, classic JRPG underground cavern music

request_description: Melancholy piano piece with slow tempo, minor key, and a feeling of loss and longing

spec.description: A tender, melancholic solo piano piece drifting through sparse, resonant notes with long sustain and gentle dynamics. The melody carries a deep sense of loss and yearning, with quiet pauses that echo emptiness and unresolved longing. Soft pedal reverb blurs the edges of each phrase, evoking bittersweet memory and quiet grief.
spec.style_hint: Nobuo Uematsu emotional piano style, reminiscent of JRPG farewell themes

request_description: Nostalgic 16-bit era title theme with chiptune arpeggios layered over modern synth pads

spec.description: A warm, nostalgic title screen theme blending classic 16-bit chiptune arpeggios with lush modern synthesizer pads. Bright square-wave and triangle-wave melodies dance over soft ambient synth layers, evoking the feel of a beloved SNES-era RPG opening while carrying a contemporary emotional depth.
spec.style_hint: SNES 16-bit era title screen, Yasunori Mitsuda / early Square RPG aesthetic with modern lo-fi synth layering

request_description: Short triumphant victory jingle with bright brass, rising scales, and celebratory energy

spec.description: A short triumphant victory jingle bursting with bright brass fanfare and rapidly rising scales, conveying jubilant celebration. Punchy trumpets and French horns swell upward in a crescendo of victory, supported by crisp snare drum rolls and shimmering cymbals. The tone is bold, radiant, and instantly rewarding.
spec.style_hint: classic JRPG victory fanfare, Nobuo Uematsu Final Fantasy style

request_description: Something that sounds like a video game

spec.description: Upbeat chiptune melody with punchy 8-bit arpeggios and bouncy square-wave leads over a driving percussion beat, evoking the feel of a classic platformer adventure. Bright synth bass pulses underneath while sparkling digital sound effects weave through the energetic, playful texture.
spec.style_hint: classic NES/SNES era platformer, early Nintendo style
